retrievalProfile.description: A romantic silhouette of a couple dancing in a blue-toned tunnel with dynamic light streaks and bold, mixed-weight slab serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, long-exposure photograph of a couple in silhouette dancing behind a wrought-iron fence inside a tunnel, dominated by cyan and teal tones with white light streaks converging toward the center, topped with heavy slab-serif and sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette of couple against a bright, receding tunnel perspective
Horizontal wrought-iron fence acting as a mid-ground anchor
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy contrasting with the dark lower silhouette
Converging light streaks creating a sense of motion and depth
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue/cyan color cast on the environment
High-contrast black silhouette of the subjects
Converging perspective lines toward a central vanishing point

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Couple in silhouette positioned right of center, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, horizontal wrought-iron fence in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold yellow title at the top, follows the light streaks down the tunnel to the dancing couple, and rests on the tracklist at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of textured blue tunnel walls and ceiling providing breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and teal blue tones for the environment and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the silhouettes and foreground fence.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white light streaks and black silhouettes; muted saturation in the blues.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, black, white, and yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses thick, blocky slab serifs with rounded terminals
Secondary text uses clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif
Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' in title has a distinctive looped descender
Uppercase 'K' in artist name has a wide stance
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a friendly, heavy slab serif with a formal, clean sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and rounded feel of the title.
Matches the geometric, all-caps sans-serif used for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a long-exposure photograph inside a cyan-toned tunnel. A couple is seen in a black silhouette dancing in the mid-ground. A black wrought-iron fence runs horizontally across the lower third. Bright white light streaks converge from the edges toward the center vanishing point.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in a heavy yellow slab-serif font at the top left. Place the artist name in white all-caps sans-serif immediately below it. Add a small tracklist in yellow sans-serif at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cyan, black, white, and yellow?
Is the couple rendered as a pure black silhouette?
Does the title use a heavy slab-serif font?
Are there visible light streaks creating perspective?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue background.
Ensure the fence does not obscure the couple's pose.
Verify the light streaks converge naturally toward the center.
Confirm the grain texture feels like vintage film stock.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a monochromatic environmental silhouette with high-contrast, mixed-weight retro typography.
